contentPolicy: Names and short exclusion reasons only; no copied third-party descriptions are retained.

items.candidate: Mae Chaem rice terraces and weaving sites
items.reason: No single site identity, responsible authority and exact parent were jointly verified from an official source.

items.candidate: Doi Saket hot-spring and community sites
items.reason: These candidates remain unsupported; Huai Hong Khrai was admitted separately from direct provincial evidence.
Seasonal/general destination references did not establish a stable attraction record.

items.candidate: Tha Ton temple and river sites
items.reason: Exact site authority and current assertion-level evidence remain incomplete; Roi Jai Rak Garden was admitted separately from project-owner and official district sources.

Official sources reviewed did not jointly confirm one stable attraction identity, its current responsible authority and an exact district assertion; MAIIAM was admitted separately from its owner page.
Broad project references were not sufficient evidence of one current visitor attraction; Maejo University's Thai Agricultural Culture Museum was admitted separately.

items.candidate: Wiang Kum Kam locality and individual monuments
items.reason: The official source identifies the archaeological locality in Tha Wang Tan but does not define one visitor-attraction identity; each monument needs its own parent and authority evidence across the Mueang Chiang Mai–Saraphi boundary.
The official source states that the park spans Chom Thong, Hot and Mae Chaem, so it cannot support a singular Hot attraction parent without a site-level entrance or attraction locator.

items.candidate: Wiang Haeng historic and mountain sites
items.reason: No candidate completed identity, current authority and exact site-level parent verification. Doi Dam is explicitly described on the Wiang Haeng–Pai boundary and cannot be assigned to one district.
Current responsible-authority and site identity evidence were incomplete; only the district-specific Doi Wiang Pha public-service unit was admitted.
Excluded from Mae Wang because provincial evidence places the attraction in Doi Lo; park naming is not used to override the site parent.
Current responsible-authority evidence supporting exact parent and visitor facts was not obtained.
Broad or ambiguous Wat Chan candidates remain excluded; the specifically named Ban Wat Chan Forest Plantation was admitted from a direct owner source.
The official source reviewed describes future tourism development rather than establishing a current visitor attraction with a direct district locator.
The park spans multiple districts and no Chai Prakan-specific entrance or visitor point was established.
Area-level evidence did not establish a Mae Wang-specific entrance or visitor attraction point.
Official PRD reporting places the viewpoint on the boundary between Wiang Haeng, Chiang Mai and Pai, Mae Hong Son; no district-specific entrance or visitor point was established.

items.candidate: Doi Wiang Pha National Park area
items.reason: Official DNP evidence describes the park across several districts, while the district-specific source identifies only a public-assistance unit and does not prove an attraction or visitor point suitable for the catalog.
